{{Quote|Master Fisto's fleet was near Gunray's position.|Luminara Unduli, to Yoda and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Cloak" />}}
'''Master Fisto's fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] following the [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescue]] of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. In the aftermath of the rescue, Jedi General [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] reported to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that Fisto's fleet was near Gunray's position.<ref name="Cloak" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Fisto's fleet was mentioned in "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," the ninth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the animated TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Cloak" /> The episode aired on [[December 8]], [[2008]].<ref name="Cloak of Darkness Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>
